liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Lazy Lightning** (2 reviews): The Lazy Lightning into Supplication stretch sounds good, lively, with the instruments mixed well [7][8]
- **Estimated Prophet** (2 reviews): Reviewer's highlight is Estimated into St. Stephen into Truckin', which was later released on Dick's Picks; Estimated is called one of the best ever heard, with energetic, original jams, beating the 11/5 version [11][13]
- **Good Lovin'** (1 review): Reviewer wishes Sunrise, Good Lovin', Ship of Fools, Scarlet-Fire and Terrapin had fit on a fourth Dick's Picks disc [10]
- **Saint Stephen** (1 review): Reviewer finds the Scarlet, Fire, St. Stephen sequence really well done [16]

## The recordings

- **gd1977-11-02.mtx.sirmick.86546.sbeok.flac16** (recommended): matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 181 min; rated 4/5 by 4 [1]. Said about its sound: Matrix of soundboard and audience; more audience in the mix than the other upload, with a peppy, well-balanced instrument blend; This source has more audience in the mix and is less soundboard-driven than the other source; some imperfections noted [7][9]
- **gd1977-11-02.mtx.chappell.sb23.86233.sbeok.flac16**: matrix (soundboard mixed with audience mics); 21 songs; 180 min; rated 3.25/5 by 4 [2]. Said about its sound: Matrix of soundboard and audience; more audience in the mix than the other upload, with a peppy, well-balanced instrument blend; Matrix sounds brighter than the Ganz soundboard reel, and its pitch seems more correct; Audience source got a 2dB shelf EQ from 1.5kHz; Waves L2 limiting kept levels from clipping [2][8][17]
- **gd1977-11-02.167734.ShureSM57.Sublette.noel.goldey.t-flac2496**: source not stated; 21 songs; 158 min; rated 5/5 by 1 [4]
- **gd77-11-02.sbd.samaritano.14743.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 21 songs; 151 min; rated 4/5 by 12 [5]. Said about its sound: This soundboard sounds richer and more balanced than the Dick's Picks source, which is thin and squished with low bass; Equalizer was used to brighten the rather dull original sound [5][16]

## Around the show

- Seneca College sat at the far northeast edge of Toronto, near farm fields, on a bleak, cold November night [14]
- Dead were not very popular in Toronto then because CHUM-FM, the only rock station, didn't play them [14]
- Reviewer thinks Keith's piano sounds different in the year's second half than in the first half [7]
- Reviewer thinks Keith's piano sounds different in the year's second half than in the first half [8]
- Suggests imperfections may be why the show missed the Dick's Picks selection [9]
- Dick's Picks 34 used seven songs from this show plus the 11/5/77 Rochester show [10]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1977-11-02.mtx.sirmick.86546.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by SIRMick; source: SBD (14743) + AUD (81012) [1]
- **gd1977-11-02.mtx.chappell.sb23.86233.sbeok.flac16**: transferred by Chris Chappell; source: SBD (14743) + AUD (81012) [2]. Also: Matrix splits Scarlet/Fire, Me and My Uncle/Big River and Lazy Lightning/Supplication into separate tracks, unlike the Ganz soundboard reel; Soundboard pitched up 12 to 20 cents, audience down 9 to 16 cents; roughly 3:1 soundboard-to-audience ratio [2][17]
- **gd1977-11-02.167734.ShureSM57.Sublette.noel.goldey.t-flac2496**: taped by Kathy Sublette; transferred by DSF Transfer by Mark Goldey Edited & Mastered by Joe Noel November 20, 2023; source: Shure SM57 mics > Sony-TC158 (Dolby on) [4]
- **gd77-11-02.sbd.samaritano.14743.sbeok.shnf**: source: Soundboard Reel> CD> TC2000 EQ> Sonic Solutions (David Gans)> CD> EAC> SHN TC2000 [5]

## Art and photos

- Fan art by johnsdeadart.blogspot.com: [John's Custom Grateful Dead Album Cover Art](https://johnsdeadart.blogspot.com/2017/05/blog-post_6.html) [19]
- Fan art by LiveGRATEFUL.net: [Grateful Dead 1977-11-02 Wed Field House, Seneca College, Toronto, Canada](https://www.livegrateful.net/post/1424028201480/grateful-dead-1977-11-02-wed-field-house) [20]
- Fan art by Jerry Garcia: [Field House, Seneca College, Toronto, Ontario, Canada - 11/02/1977 - Jerry Garcia](https://jerrygarcia.com/image/field-house-seneca-college-toronto-ontario-canada-11-02-1977-5/) [21]
